invariants.description: Every explanation must correspond to the exact prediction execution it claims to explain.
invariants.evidence: POST /predict/explain resolves active serving_model and binds explanation directly to model output.

invariants.description: The explainer must use the same model parameters/version as the prediction being explained.
invariants.evidence: Explainer cache is keyed by (model_key, id(model), tuple(FEATURE_NAMES), baseline.shape, baseline_fp); hot-swapping creates new explainer instances.

invariants.description: The explainer must receive the intended representation of the same logical input.
Prediction and explanation paths must use semantically identical preprocessing.
invariants.evidence: Both SHAP and LIME consume preprocess_transaction(txn) in [0, 1] range.

invariants.description: Attribution index i must correspond to the feature occupying model input position i.
invariants.evidence: SHAP_FEATURE_NAMES aligns 100% with FEATURE_NAMES in data_generator, and tuple(FEATURE_NAMES) is bound into explainer cache key.

invariants.description: User-visible feature names must remain bound to the correct attribution values.
invariants.evidence: Adversarial feature value shifts propagate strictly with their associated feature keys.

invariants.description: Explanation semantics must explicitly correspond to the quantity actually explained (positive-class fraud probability output in [0, 1]).
invariants.evidence: predict_fn returns sigmoid probability scores in [0, 1], matching direct model inference to < 1e-6 numerical tolerance.

invariants.description: Expected/reference/baseline values must correspond to the explainer and output space actually used.
invariants.evidence: explainer.expected_value evaluated over baseline population in probability space; baseline content fingerprint prevents stale baseline collision.

invariants.description: Attribution decomposition must locally reconstruct the model output: f(x) == E[f(x)] + sum(phi_i).
invariants.evidence: Measured across 10 distinct samples with nsamples=100: max absolute reconstruction error = 3.44e-4, mean error = 1.55e-4.

invariants.description: Positive/negative attribution labels must correspond to their actual mathematical direction.
invariants.evidence: Verified with deterministic linear oracle: positive weights yield positive attributions.

invariants.description: Top-feature ordering must derive from the intended attribution ranking rule.
invariants.evidence: Features sorted descending by abs(contribution) with preserved raw feature values.

invariants.description: Heuristic/approximate explanations must not be represented as exact SHAP/model attribution.
invariants.evidence: FastInferenceExplainer reports method=fast_heuristic; fallback reports fallback_heuristic; UI renders amber FALLBACK HEURISTIC badge.

invariants.description: Cached explanations must be keyed by every state dimension necessary (tenant, transaction_id, model, as_of, feature fingerprint, baseline).
invariants.evidence: Realtime cache keys use cfi:shap:{tenant_id}:{transaction_id}:m_{m}:t_{t}:f_{f}; KernelExplainer cache uses (model_key, id(model), tuple(FEATURE_NAMES), baseline.shape, baseline_fp).

invariants.description: Explanation failure must not silently produce fabricated reason codes or successful-looking explanations.
invariants.evidence: Non-finite values raise explicit ValueError; LIME surrogate fits with R^2 < 0.50 append explicit low-fidelity cautions.

invariants.description: NaN/Inf explanation values must not be serialized as valid explanation output.
invariants.evidence: Assert np.all(np.isfinite(shap_matrix)) enforces strict mathematical validity before serialization.

invariants.description: Explanation paths described as deterministic must be reproducible under equivalent state.
invariants.evidence: np.random state saved and restored with local scoped seed=42 for KernelExplainer sampling.

invariants.description: Where graph state contributes to explanation, explanation must correspond to graph state legitimately used.
invariants.evidence: explain_gnn_embedding enforces Guarantee A (event-time cutoff isolation: edges > as_of excluded; late-arriving records <= as_of participate).

invariants.description: API/frontend explanation output must preserve the semantics produced by the explanation engine.
invariants.evidence: _get_top_features preserves true raw value; Predictor.tsx and AlertsPage.tsx render directional +/- sign, continuous magnitude bars, and fallback heuristic badges.
